date_range: Event dates 2022-05-09 through 2024-08-05 with return support through 2026-04-14
limitation: Event windows are not an identification design.
method: Registered fixed post-event windows compared with non-overlapping empirical placebo windows
research_question: How do registered post-event windows vary across BTC and ETH?
sample: Registered events within the valid 2020-2026 BTC/ETH panel
uncertainty: Empirical placebo percentiles and two-sided placebo p-values; not an identification design
